name: M3_MMS200MI_LstSumWhsBal
description: List summarized warehouse balance information for all items linked to a specific warehouse and alias number. The result is one record per item and warehouse, showing total on‑hand quantities by status (approved, under inspection, rejected), allocatable and available quantities, safety stock, reorder point, and key planning data such as lead time, lead time date and planning time fence. The list also includes action messages and allocation stop information used by material planning, together with selected item/warehouse settings from the item‑warehouse master (for example ABC class and note text). Use this operation to obtain an inventory overview driven by an alias or barcode instead of the internal item number.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse for which summarized item balances are listed.

inputParameters.name: POPN
inputParameters.description: Alias number identifying the item whose warehouse balance is listed.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company for which the summarized item/warehouse balances are retrieved.

inputParameters.name: LNCD
inputParameters.description: Language code used when retrieving language-dependent descriptions in the list.

inputParameters.name: INVF
inputParameters.description: Controls whether only items with non-zero inventory balances are included in the list.

inputParameters.name: CHCD
inputParameters.description: Configuration code used to select items with a specific configuration.

inputParameters.name: AFLM
inputParameters.description: Controls whether all available fields, including descriptions and low-priority data, are returned in the list.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company for the summarized item/warehouse record.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse for the summarized item/warehouse record.

outputParameters.name: POPN
outputParameters.description: Alias number identifying the summarized item.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number.

outputParameters.name: WHNM
outputParameters.description: Name of the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Item description.

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Status of the summarized item/warehouse record.

outputParameters.name: QUQT
outputParameters.description: On-hand balance quantity under inspection for the item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: UNMS
outputParameters.description: Basic unit of measure in which the item is stocked.

outputParameters.name: LEAT
outputParameters.description: Total lead time in days for the item in this warehouse.

outputParameters.name: LTDT
outputParameters.description: Earliest availability date based on today’s date and the item’s lead time.

outputParameters.name: RJQT
outputParameters.description: Rejected on-hand balance quantity for the item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: PFTM
outputParameters.description: Planning time fence in days used when planning this item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: PFDT
outputParameters.description: Calendar date corresponding to the planning time fence for this item/warehouse.

outputParameters.name: STQT
outputParameters.description: Approved on-hand balance quantity for the item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for this item/warehouse record.

outputParameters.name: ORQT
outputParameters.description: Total ordered quantity for the item in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: ACT1
outputParameters.description: First line of the action message text for the item/warehouse balance.

outputParameters.name: ACT2
outputParameters.description: Second line of the action message text for the item/warehouse balance.

outputParameters.name: ACT3
outputParameters.description: Third line of the action message text for the item/warehouse balance.

outputParameters.name: ACT4
outputParameters.description: Fourth line of the action message text for the item/warehouse balance.

outputParameters.name: ACT5
outputParameters.description: Fifth line of the action message text for the item/warehouse balance.

outputParameters.name: ACT6
outputParameters.description: Sixth line of the action message text for the item/warehouse balance.

outputParameters.name: ACT7
outputParameters.description: Reply time associated with the action message for this item/warehouse.

outputParameters.name: REQT
outputParameters.description: Total quantity reserved for the item from the current date onward.

outputParameters.name: ALAR
outputParameters.description: Forecast alarm indicator used in planning for this item/warehouse.

outputParameters.name: AV02
outputParameters.description: Quantity available in inventory disregarding reservation timing.

outputParameters.name: PUIT
outputParameters.description: Acquisition code defining whether supply for the item is created by manufacturing, purchasing, distribution, or maintenance.

outputParameters.name: SSQT
outputParameters.description: Safety stock quantity kept as buffer for this item/warehouse.

outputParameters.name: AVAL
outputParameters.description: Portion of the on-hand balance that is available for allocation.

outputParameters.name: REOP
outputParameters.description: Stock level at which a new replenishment order should be created.

outputParameters.name: ALQT
outputParameters.description: Allocated quantity of the item in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: ASOT
outputParameters.description: Type of stop applied to automatic allocation for this item/warehouse.

outputParameters.name: VTDT
outputParameters.description: Valid-to date for the current item/warehouse balance control settings.

outputParameters.name: EOQT
outputParameters.description: Normal order quantity used when replenishing the item in this warehouse.

outputParameters.name: AV01
outputParameters.description: Net allocatable quantity after considering allocations and non-allocatable balances.

outputParameters.name: ABCD
outputParameters.description: ABC class for the item in the warehouse based on sales volume.

outputParameters.name: STTX
outputParameters.description: Free-text note for the summarized item/warehouse record.

outputParameters.name: CHCD
outputParameters.description: Configuration code indicating whether and how the item is configurable.

outputParameters.name: STCW
outputParameters.description: Approved on-hand balance expressed in catch weight unit of measure (deprecated field kept for compatibility).

outputParameters.name: RJCW
outputParameters.description: Rejected on-hand balance expressed in catch weight unit of measure (deprecated field kept for compatibility).

outputParameters.name: QUCW
outputParameters.description: On-hand balance under inspection expressed in catch weight unit of measure (deprecated field kept for compatibility).
